rows.grounds: prescribes the action against the enemy
the act of consideration or reflection

items.question: Is deliberation permitted when the practitioner acts to kill an enemy?
premises: The enemy is to be killed.
Deliberation is not to be done in this case.
The prescribed action admits no hesitation.
items.inference: The practitioner should kill the enemy without any deliberation.
uncertainties: The specific ritual context of 'atra' depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: One should kill the enemy; no deliberation is to be made in this matter.
